actual_view_detail: original for native and both QA reductions

mandatory_conditions.required: 검은 글자와 흰 단색 배경만 사용한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Black lettering on near-white field, but faint diagonal streaking is visible throughout the native blank background.

mandatory_conditions.required: 원문 한 문자열을 각 이미지에 정확히 한 번 표시한다. 원문에 있는 두 번의 '숨'을 임의 중복으로 오판하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: One phrase, exactly five syllables; both supplied 숨 are present, no extra text.
No illustration, icon, shape, border, divider, symbol or extra copy; faint repeated diagonal background streaking is the remaining texture defect.

mandatory_conditions.required: 어절을 보존하고 어절 사이 줄바꿈만 허용한다. 글자 내부 구조를 장식 그림으로 해체하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: All three intact words sit on one baseline; full conventional Hangul glyph structure.

mandatory_conditions.required: 사용자가 비율을 지정하지 않았으므로 다섯 장 모두 세로 2:3으로 만든다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Measured 1024 by 1536, exact 2:3; zero relative ratio deviation.

observations.observation: Crisp bold upright Hangul, readable internal spaces and intact five syllables; normal spacing within words. No clipping or overlap.

observations.location: Gap between 과 and the second 숨
observations.observation: The white interval is about one glyph wide and larger than the gap between 숨 and 사이. The entire phrase remains a single line. Left and right margins are balanced.

observations.location: Entire poster at 720 width and 320 long side
observations.observation: The only phrase dominates clearly; both the widened interval and all three words remain visible at thumbnail size.
Faint low-contrast diagonal streaking is visible at native detail and 720; this violates the required untextured white field.
The unrequested microtexture is a generic rendering artifact, not needed for the typographic idea. No fake writing, ornaments or malformed syllables observed.

uncertainties: Very low-contrast background variation is less apparent in the 320 reduction; assessed from native and 720 views.
defects_to_correct: Remove the faint diagonal streaking and all canvas variation; preserve exact text, glyph form, gap and baseline.
